<?php

class FeatureFlags {
    private array $flags;
    private string $configPath;

    public function __construct(string $configDir) {
        $this->configPath = rtrim($configDir, '/') . '/';
        $this->flags = $this->loadFlags();
    }

    private function loadFlags(): array {
        $file = $this->configPath . 'features.json';
        if (!file_exists($file)) return [];
        return json_decode(file_get_contents($file), true) ?? [];
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flag): bool {
        return isset($this->flags[$flag]) && $this->flags[$flag] === true;
    }
}

class ImagePathResolver {
    private string $baseDir;
    private FeatureFlags $features;

    public function __construct(string $baseDir, FeatureFlags $features) {
        $this->baseDir = realpath($baseDir);
        $this->features = $features;
    }

    public function resolve(string $userInput): string {
        if ($this->features->isEnabled('unicode_filenames')) {
            $userInput = $this->applyNFCNormalization($userInput);
        }

        $normalized = $this->sanitizeFilename($userInput);
        $fullPath = $this->baseDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . $normalized;

        return $fullPath;
    }

    public function getBaseDir(): string {
        return $this->baseDir;
    }

    private function sanitizeFilename(string $input): string {
        // Remove null bytes
        $clean = str_replace("\x00", '', $input);
        // Remove directory traversal sequences
        $clean = str_replace(['../', '..\\'], '', $clean);
        // Remove leading slashes
        $clean = ltrim($clean, '/\\');
        // Additional: remove any remaining path separators
        $clean = basename($clean);
        return $clean;
    }

    private function applyNFCNormalization(string $input): string {
        if (!extension_loaded('intl')) {
            return $input;
        }
        // Normalize to NFC form for consistent Unicode handling
        return \Normalizer::normalize($input, \Normalizer::FORM_C);
    }
}

class ImageProcessor {
    private ImagePathResolver $resolver;
    private FeatureFlags $features;
    private string $outputDir;

    public function __construct(ImagePathResolver $resolver, FeatureFlags $features, string $outputDir) {
        $this->resolver = $resolver;
        $this->features = $features;
        $this->outputDir = rtrim($outputDir, '/');
    }

    public function processUpload(string $filename, string $operation = 'thumbnail'): array {
        $sourcePath = $this->resolver->resolve($filename);

        if (!$this->validatePath($sourcePath)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid image path');
        }

        if (!file_exists($sourcePath)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Image not found');
        }

        $imageInfo = getimagesize($sourcePath);
        if ($imageInfo === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid image file');
        }

        return $this->applyOperation($sourcePath, $operation, $imageInfo);
    }

    private function validatePath(string $path): bool {
        // Resolve the real path for validation
        $resolved = realpath($path);
        if ($resolved === false) {
            return false;
        }

        $baseDir = $this->resolver->getBaseDir();
        if ($baseDir === false || $baseDir === '') {
            return false;
        }

        // Check the path is within allowed directory.
        // Use a trailing separator to avoid sibling-prefix bypass
        // (e.g. /var/uploads matching /var/uploads_evil).
        $baseWithSep = rtrim($baseDir, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
        if ($resolved !== rtrim($baseDir, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR)
            && strpos($resolved, $baseWithSep) !== 0) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate file extension
        $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($resolved, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        $allowed = ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp'];
        return in_array($ext, $allowed, true);
    }

    private function applyOperation(string $path, string $op, array $info): array {
        $width = $info[0];
        $height = $info[1];

        switch ($op) {
            case 'thumbnail':
                $newWidth = min(150, $width);
                $newHeight = (int)($height * ($newWidth / $width));
                break;
            case 'medium':
                $newWidth = min(800, $width);
                $newHeight = (int)($height * ($newWidth / $width));
                break;
            default:
                $newWidth = $width;
                $newHeight = $height;
        }

        return [
            'source' => $path,
            'width' => $newWidth,
            'height' => $newHeight,
            'operation' => $op
        ];
    }
}

class ImagePipelineController {
    private ImageProcessor $processor;

    public function __construct(string $uploadDir, string $configDir, string $outputDir) {
        $features = new FeatureFlags($configDir);
        $resolver = new ImagePathResolver($uploadDir, $features);
        $this->processor = new ImageProcessor($resolver, $features, $outputDir);
    }

    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $filename = $request['filename'] ?? '';
        $operation = $request['operation'] ?? 'thumbnail';

        if (empty($filename)) {
            return ['error' => 'No filename provided', 'status' => 400];
        }

        // Whitelist operation values
        $allowedOps = ['thumbnail', 'medium', 'original'];
        if (!in_array($operation, $allowedOps, true)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid operation', 'status' => 400];
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->processor->processUpload($filename, $operation);
            return ['success' => true, 'data' => $result, 'status' => 200];
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            return ['error' => $e->getMessage(), 'status' => 422];
        }
    }
}

    __DIR__ . '/config',
